entries.73fc854bc21e1db2: Using a manufacturer-direct D2C model, in which it handles everything from planning through manufacturing to shipping in-house, the company achieves low prices and short lead times. Its strength lies in a structure that efficiently processes small-lot, multi-item orders, supported by in-house developed systems such as the EC site construction system "DREAM-PACK" and the manufacturing management system "i-backyard" and by automation of print data processing. On its major sites, it ranks first in organic search for the search keywords 'nobori' and 'nobori-hata', and approximately 75% of the sales mix of 'Nobori King' consists of repeat orders. The consolidated subsidiary has silk screen printing equipment and a corporate customer base, and the two companies complement each other: the company handles small lots, while the subsidiary handles medium and large lots.

entries.f0d2f6cedc9f07d4: Digitalization of business-to-business transactions is progressing, with the BtoB-EC market reaching ¥514.4069 trillion in 2024 and the EC penetration rate rising to 43.1%. Meanwhile, the commercial printing market is expected to remain flat at ¥1.75 trillion in 2025, and against this backdrop, the adoption of digital printing is accelerating on demand for short lead times, small lots and variable data, a situation described as one in which differences in capability determine orders. In promotion and advertising, promotional media advertising spending has remained firm, with 'Events, exhibitions, video and others' showing high growth, and the company believes there is room to capture promotional demand, including event venue decoration.
